SYNTHETIC FIXTURE -- fabricated prose written for this test, not an excerpt from any
publication. It exists only to exercise tools/originality_check.py.

The proposed retrieval pipeline encodes each document into a dense vector and
compares candidate passages with a cosine similarity threshold. That threshold is
tuned on the development split before any test evaluation is performed, and the
tuning script is committed alongside the run metadata.

Annotation was carried out by two raters who labelled every third item and then
discussed disagreements until a consensus label was recorded for the analysis.
